headline: Bond order of $36,786,032 for roof replacements at various Springfield public schools, plus grants and donations.
summary: The agenda includes a $36,786,032 bond order for school roof work. It also lists several grants, donations to the library and Elder Affairs, a fire chiefs' union contract, and a utility easement for Gerena School.
